title: prompt-library-scratchpad-jordan-kim-experiments-2
content:
Quick scratchpad for prompt library experiments - mostly working notes, TODOs, and a few few-shot templates.

Context / intent:
- Collect templates and small few-shot sets for customer-facing assistants and internal QA.
- Track failure cases and abbreviated error traces so we can create focused evals and guardrails.
- Experiment with instruction framing and system-message variations (temperature, bad-word filters, role prompts).

Notes to self (questions):
- Should we standardize on 3-shot or 5-shot for QA sets? 3-shot seems faster but some intents need 5 to cover edge behavior.
- Use balanced positive/negative examples (equal numbers) to avoid biasing classification head for reranking tasks.
- Add a regression test whenever we update a template used by >5 customers.

Prompt templates (move to canonical library if stable):
1) Intent classification (short):
- System: "You are an assistant that extracts intent labels from customer messages. Reply ONLY with the label (one word)."
- Few-shot examples (3):
  EX1: "Hi, my subscription billing shows extra charge" => billing
  EX2: "How do I set up single-sign-on for my team?" => setup
  EX3: "Model responses are slower than usual, what's happening?" => performance
- User: "Our invoices show duplicate entries, can you check?"
- Expected output: "billing"

2) Summarization + action items (template):
- System: "You are a concise meeting summarizer. Output JSON with keys: summary, action_items (bullet list). If no action items, return an empty list."
- Prompt: paste meeting notes.
- Failure mode observed: hallucinated action items when system message not strict. Need to add explicit filter: "If uncertain, ask for clarification."

3) Persona-based assistant (for product demos):
- System: "You are a friendly product expert for Redwood Inference. Use non-technical language for customers labeled 'pm' and use technical depth for 'eng'."
- Shots included for pm and eng.

Few-shot examples (scratch):
- For classification of policy violations (safety): show examples of flagged vs allowed content. Keep explicit edge cases (sarcasm, hypotheticals) to teach boundaries.

Failure cases log (recent experiments):
- 2026-01-15: Few-shot intent model incorrectly labeled "billing dispute" as "support" when user wrote: "I want my refund for duplicated invoice". Root cause: training examples under-represented 'refund' phrasing. Fix: add 6 more refund-specific shots; add negative sample for ambiguous phrasing.
- 2026-02-02: Summarizer produced non-actionable action item: "Follow up" (no owner/date). Fix: enforce action_item structure: {task, owner (optional), due_date (optional), confidence}.
- 2026-02-20: Persona assistant leaked system instructions into response when prompt injection present. Mitigation: sanitize user input, prepend system reminder about not repeating system tokens.

Evaluation ideas / metrics to track per template:
- Exact-match for classification labels (macro F1); also track confusion matrix for top-3 labels.
- For summarization, ROUGE-L plus human-rated utility (1-5) on 200 samples. Track hallucination rate (asserted facts not present in source).
- Latency and token cost per template (avg tokens in shots + response). Maintain expected cost budget per customer tier.

Quick experiments to run (backlog):
- [ ] Compare 3-shot vs 5-shot classification F1 on a 1k held-out set (split by domain: billing, setup, performance).
- [ ] Test strict-system vs soft-system wording for summarizer hallucination rates.
- [ ] Generate adversarial prompts (prompt-injection style) to stress persona template and measure percent of unsafe outputs.
- [ ] Create minimal canonical header for every few-shot template describing: purpose, expected outputs, failure modes, sample size used in tests.

TODO / next steps:
- Move stable templates (intent classification, summarizer) into prompt library repo and add PR referencing JIRA-INF-3421.
- Create small eval harness in GH actions to run smoke tests on PRs that touch templates (=> deny PR if new template increases hallucination rate by >5% on smoke set).
- Align with Ava/Human-in-the-loop team for labeling ambiguous examples (Maya to coordinate).

Scratch examples (for quick copy/paste):
- "System: You are an intent classifier. Output LABEL only. Shots: ..." (see above)
- 3-shot set for 'billing' edge cases: invoice duplicate, chargeback, refund request.

Random notes / brainstorms (unstructured):
- Could add small synthetic negative examples via paraphrasing to increase robustness.
- Consider language-specific templates for FR/DE support, but keep core shots language-agnostic when possible.
- Maybe use small LLM distilled models for quick local testing of templates before running on infra.

Linked tickets / references:
- JIRA-INF-3421: canonical prompt library rollout (TODO: add acceptance criteria)
- GH PR 78: initial harness and README for prompt formats

If this doc gets stable, copy canonical header to repo and add an example-run notebook. For now - rough notes.

-- Jordan
